Game Overview

Scooter Brothers is a two-player title where race through vibrant streets in Scooter Brothers, evading persistent police and scavenging for fuel. Outmaneuver danger with tight swerves and timely jumps, utilizing the "Black Hole" power for epic escapes. Join a friend for double the thrills in this fast-paced, reflex-driven adventure.
